title: WP15-D4 explicit freeze decision

reviewer.name: Aman Singh
reviewer.conflict_statement: The reviewer is the repository owner and research author. This is an internal protocol decision and is not independent validation.

question_responses.subject: review target
question_responses.criterion: The review target is the exact locally validated D4 checkpoint and no later unreviewed candidate mutation is included.
question_responses.rationale: The locally validated D4 candidate is pinned to 34d63a554646baddd9fadf58678cfe70392fc41d. The D4R review package is separately pinned to d321f927aff20636490ae8c8cf407410e42c6fbe.

question_responses.subject: outcome blindness
question_responses.criterion: The reviewer has not inspected projected values, raw values, family outcomes, aggregate results, or ranking information.
question_responses.rationale: The review used contracts, identifiers, hashes, field names, validation results, and governance records only. No projected values, raw values, family outcomes, aggregates, rates, or rankings were viewed.

question_responses.subject: family population
question_responses.criterion: The exact qualified family order CF-01, CF-02, CF-05, and CF-06 is justified for the candidate review scope.
question_responses.rationale: The exact review population is CF-01, CF-02, CF-05, and CF-06. Each is classified as QUALIFIED_MATCH by D2; diagnostic-only families remain excluded.

question_responses.subject: member registry
question_responses.criterion: The 13 declared member rows are complete, unique, and traceable to the D2/D3 contracts.
question_responses.rationale: The D2, D3, and D4 contracts identify 13 unique member rows. Focused tests and validators confirmed exact identity and traceability.

question_responses.subject: analysis units
question_responses.criterion: The 12 treatment-within-family analysis units are complete and do not treat member rows as independent denominator units.
question_responses.rationale: The registry contains 12 unique treatment-within-family analysis units. Member rows are traceability records and are not independent denominator units.

question_responses.subject: CF-02 policy variants
question_responses.criterion: B1-01 and B1-05 remain separate traceability rows under the single CF-02:B1 analysis unit.
question_responses.rationale: CF-02 B1-01 and B1-05 remain separate member rows under the single CF-02:B1 analysis unit and cannot be double-counted.

question_responses.subject: CF-01 cutoff
question_responses.criterion: OC-CF01-TERMINAL-ORACLE is terminal, non-adaptive, and does not permit a post-terminal message or additional recovery attempt.
question_responses.rationale: OC-CF01-TERMINAL-ORACLE stops at the declared source executor terminal state and prohibits any post-terminal message or additional recovery. Oracle validation is registry-admission control only and cannot extend observation or authorize a result-selective rerun.

question_responses.subject: CF-02 cutoff
question_responses.criterion: OC-CF02-NO-FAULT-COMPLETION is terminal, applies consistently to both B1 policy variants, and does not extend observation after a result.
question_responses.rationale: OC-CF02-NO-FAULT-COMPLETION stops after each exact no-fault source transaction reaches its declared terminal state and oracle validation completes. The two B1 policy variants remain separate traceability rows under one CF-02:B1 analysis unit. No execution is extended after its result is known.

question_responses.subject: CF-05 cutoff
question_responses.criterion: OC-CF05-STATUS-OPPORTUNITY stops after the declared telemetry opportunity and prohibits a replacement opportunity or recovery extension.
question_responses.rationale: OC-CF05-STATUS-OPPORTUNITY stops immediately after the single declared post-convergence status-telemetry opportunity is processed and the terminal classification is recorded. No replacement telemetry opportunity or recovery extension is allowed.

question_responses.subject: CF-06 cutoff
question_responses.criterion: OC-CF06-SINGLE-REPLAY permits exactly one declared replay evaluation after successful advancement and no additional replay, retry, or recovery action.
question_responses.rationale: OC-CF06-SINGLE-REPLAY permits exactly one declared replay evaluation after successful state advancement. Rejection and unchanged-state checks must complete, after which no additional replay, retry, or recovery action is permitted.

question_responses.subject: allowed fields
question_responses.criterion: Every family allowed-field list matches the authoritative D2 matrix in membership and order without widening.
question_responses.rationale: Every family allowed-field list matches the authoritative D2 matrix in exact membership and order. The earlier widening defect was corrected, the builder remains fail-closed, and no field outside the family registry is permitted.

question_responses.subject: missing units
question_responses.criterion: A missing declared analysis unit blocks the family display and never shrinks the denominator.
question_responses.rationale: A missing declared treatment-within-family analysis unit marks coverage incomplete and blocks the family display. The denominator cannot shrink to exclude a missing or unfavorable unit.

question_responses.subject: extra units
question_responses.criterion: An undeclared analysis unit is rejected and never expands the denominator.
question_responses.rationale: An undeclared analysis unit is rejected and cannot expand the denominator. New members require a versioned pre-observation candidate and repeated validation.

question_responses.subject: display registry
question_responses.criterion: Only identity, membership, cutoff, allowed-field-name, and coverage-completeness planning displays are currently allowed; side-by-side member values remain separately gated.
question_responses.rationale: The current registry permits planning displays for identity, membership, cutoffs, allowed field names, and coverage completeness only. Side-by-side member values, rates, and aggregates remain separately gated.

question_responses.subject: revision control
question_responses.criterion: Any pre-display change requires a versioned candidate and repeated validation; any post-display change must be labeled post-observation and preserve the superseded plan.
question_responses.rationale: Any pre-display change requires a versioned candidate, rationale, validator update, and repeated review. Any post-display change must be labeled post-observation, preserve the superseded plan and outputs, and cannot be combined absent a later authorized protocol.

question_responses.subject: claim boundary
question_responses.criterion: The review cannot authorize success rates, pooled aggregation, inference, superiority, causal interpretation, cryptographic claims, independent validation, or publication evidence.
question_responses.rationale: This internal review cannot authorize success rates, pooled aggregation, inference, treatment ranking or superiority, causal interpretation, cryptographic claims, independent validation, or publication evidence.

decision_rationale: All 16 outcome-blind review questions passed for the exact validated WP15-D4 checkpoint. The family population, member registry, treatment-within-family analysis units, four terminal cutoffs, exact D2-authorized field lists, missing-unit and extra-unit behavior, planning-display registry, and revision controls were reviewed without viewing family outcomes or comparative values. Local validation, the complete regression suite, the tracked-file manifest, and both required pull-request CI workflows passed for the review-package commit.
conditions: The decision does not become freeze-effective until both required pull-request workflows succeed on the Git commit containing this decision record.
Acceptance freezes only the exact reviewed cutoffs, member registry, treatment-within-family analysis-unit denominators, and planning-display registry.
No family-member value display, success rate, pooled aggregation, inference, superiority, causal, cryptographic, independent-validation, or publication claim is authorized.

decision_record_commit_binding.verification_rule: The decision record is bound to the Git commit that contains this exact file. CI and the post-CI audit must identify that containing commit SHA.

freeze_effectiveness.effectiveness_rule: The ACCEPT decision becomes effective only when both required workflows complete successfully for the exact containing decision-record commit.
